policy_title: Restore and improve disability benefits and support
stated: Restore disability benefits with an immediate 5% uplift, end the targeting of disabled people on benefits, oppose replacing PIP with vouchers, and make free transport mandatory for 16-18-year-old SEND pupils.

source.quote: Elected Greens will: • Restore the value of disability benefits with an immediate uplift of 5%. • End the unfair targeting of carers and disabled people on benefits. • Oppose plans to replace Personal Independence Payments (PIP) cash payments with ‘vouchers’, and in the long term reform intrusive eligibility tests like PIP. • Make it mandatory for councils to provide free transport for 16–18-year-old pupils with Special Educational Needs and Disability.

bearing_set.reason: Restoring disability benefits with a 5% uplift and opposing PIP-to-voucher replacement directly affects the disposable income and ability to afford essentials for disabled benefit recipients — a non-negligible financial effect on a defined population.
Mandating free transport for 16–18-year-old SEND pupils directly removes a barrier to educational participation for that group, earning a real verdict on education access and opportunity.

Restoring disability benefit eligibility plus a 5% uplift and mandating SEND transport funding represent material, unfunded spending commitments; the mechanism is increased expenditure without a stated revenue offset, worsening the funded-vs-borrowed balance.
Targeted income transfers to disabled people — a disproportionately lower-income group — narrow the gap between top and bottom incomes, with a clear distributional mechanism.

membership_note: Four genuine bearings: O2 (income effect on essentials for disabled recipients), O7 (SEND transport and FE access), O12 (unfunded spending pressure), and O14 (pro-poor distributional effect). O9 (equal treatment) was considered but the operative mechanism here is distributional income support rather than a formal anti-discrimination or rule-of-law instrument, so it does not independently clear the non-negligible bar beyond what O2 and O14 already capture.
